body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Optoma presented its pico pocket projector 'PK201' at CES 2010, which delivers high brightness and widescreen resolution, making it ideal for sharing business presentations or entertainment.
It features 60" images size output, 6ounce weight with internal battery, LED light source lasts over 20,000 hours, connect to laptops and digital camera via HDMI or VGA.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
